parameters.jsCode: const body=$input.first().json.body;const required=['newsletter_content','subscriber_segments'];const missing=required.filter(f=>!body[f]);if(missing.length)return[{json:{valid:false,error:'Missing: '+missing.join(', ')}}];if(!Array.isArray(body.subscriber_segments)||body.subscriber_segments.length===0)return[{json:{valid:false,error:'subscriber_segments must be a non-empty array'}}];const segs=body.subscriber_segments.slice(0,8).map(s=>({segmentId:s.segment_id||('seg-'+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,7)),segmentName:(s.segment_name||'Unknown').trim(),description:(s.description||'').slice(0,300),size:parseInt(s.size)||null,sampleInterests:Array.isArray(s.sample_interests)?s.sample_interests:(s.sample_interests||'').split(',').map(i=>i.trim()).filter(Boolean),email:s.email||null}));return[{json:{valid:true,newsletterContent:body.newsletter_content.trim().slice(0,4000),newsletterTitle:(body.newsletter_title||'').trim(),newsletterGoal:(body.newsletter_goal||'').slice(0,300),brandVoice:(body.brand_voice||'friendly and informative').slice(0,200),segments:segs,replyEmail:body.reply_email||null}}];

values.content: You personalize email newsletters for different subscriber segments. Each segment gets a version of the same core content tailored to their interests, role, or stage — different subject line, different opening hook, different emphasis on which content items matter most to them, different CTA framing. The core content doesn't change, but the frame around it does. Always respond in valid JSON only.
